verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a Bounce API to manage bounced emails and reactivate addresses, plus a bounce webhook and fake-bounce generation for testing. Together these cover reading and managing hard bounces through the API. The pack contains no evidence of API access to spam-complaint or unsubscribe suppression lists, and the docs items are only one-line headings. missing for 10: documented suppression-list API covering complaints and unsubscribes, detail on listing and deleting suppressions per message stream, independent or hands-on corroboration.
